{{Otheruses|Yard}}
'''Yard 413''', also known as the '''brassyard''', was a [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The yard's [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] were responsible for overhauling the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] shortly before the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
